model_params.model: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300) — the wave-4 LOBO config, but refit on ALL cycles of B0005/B0006/B0018 (explanation model, see split)

split.protocol: EXPLANATION MODEL — deliberately NOT the wave-4 leave-one-battery-out protocol: the forest is fitted on every cycle of B0005, B0006 and B0018 so the attributions describe the fullest model of the three EOL batteries. Its metrics below are IN-SAMPLE and must not be quoted as generalisation — the honest generalisation estimate is the wave-4 LOBO record (pooled RMSE 9.27).
excluded_batteries: B0007 (censored — never crosses 1.4 Ah EOL, no RUL label)

preprocessing.target: rul_cycles_eol (discharge cycles until capacity first < 1.4 Ah)
preprocessing.note: identical feature space to the wave-4 battery records (cycle_index + adapter FEATURE_COLUMNS)

notes: Explainability record (wave 6): SHAP TreeExplainer attributions of the all-batteries Random Forest for B0005's discharge cycles, on the RUL (cycles) output scale. Attributions describe what THIS model uses — dominated, expectedly, by the capacity trajectory features — not a physical ageing mechanism. The LOBO record remains the performance reference for this dataset.
